verdict.rationale: Brex's own materials say you can 'set budgets and allocate spend limits with auto-enforced controls', and its developer docs list a Budgets API for managing budgets and budget programs. Related evidence shows card-level limits: per-transaction limits on vendor cards, monthly user limits, and card limits that reset monthly. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation tying budgets specifically to departments (the evidence shows only that departments exist in the Team API) and describing how enforcement works (hard declines vs. alerts), plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
